title: TALEC: Teach Your LLM to Evaluate in Specific Domain with In-house Criteria by Criteria Division and Zero-shot Plus Few-shot
reasoning: The paper focuses on establishing an evaluation framework for LLMs within specific business domains (specifically the automobile field). The criteria discussed are performance and quality-based (e.g., correctness, helpfulness, repetition, and technical accuracy) rather than being focused on religious, moral, or ethical benchmarking.
